sources.title: Long-term depression and other synaptic plasticity in the cerebellum

sources.role_in_article: 主要框架来源：分子级联完整描述、IP₃R1 与门机制、AMPAR 内吞步骤、LTD 与运动学习的关系

sources.title: Reevaluating the role of LTD in cerebellar motor learning
